bibl.title: Hipponax' poetic initiation and Herodas' 'Dream'.
bibl.seg: Vanessa Cazzato, Hipponax' poetic initiation and Herodas' 'Dream'.
bibl.note: Presents fresh evidence in favour of recognising in a series of late testimonia on Hipponax the vestiges of a poem in which the iambist recounted his poetic initiation. Argues that Herodas alludes to such in poem in the opening of his programmatic Mimiamb 1 and his own account of poetic investiture in Mimiamb 8.
